## DEC-04-001 — Choose name representations without erasing identity evidence

decision · domain 04 · [DEC-04-001 — Choose name representations without erasing identity evidence](../../decisions/name-representation.md)

Choose conservative normalization, parsed structure, and optional language-aware variants while retaining original names and transformation lineage. Compare exact or canonically normalized equality with multiple representations rather than one destructive cleaning function. Requires declared identity semantics, script and source context, and a distinction between retrieval keys and scoring evidence. Broader equivalence can recover plausible variants but also collapse subsidiaries, geographic qualifiers, and series distinctions; apparent string agreement is not proof of identity.

## SOL-04-001 — Non-destructive multilingual name representations

solution · domain 04 · [SOL-04-001 — Non-destructive multilingual name representations](../../solutions/normalization/name-representations.md)

Retain original names and generate a small, versioned set of canonical, parsed, and optional language-aware representations. Each form records its source, transformation, uncertainty and intended retrieval or comparison role. Requires explicit name semantics and tested transformation behavior. Multiple forms can expose otherwise hidden variants without forcing one lossy canonical string, but increase collisions, correlated features, storage and comparison cost. Script metadata and normalized equality do not establish language or identity.

Tags: `evidence-engineering`, `multilingual`, `multiscript`, `noisy`, `organization`, `person`, `provenance`.
